scope: 41 pinned Rust files, all baseline declaration anchors, retained 85 marked scenarios and four integration roots; no implementation or tests executed by this audit.
rules: A translated lexical anchor can represent only an extracted numeric component, not its live parent method.
Later inventories supersede earlier pending slices; baseline remains historical.
Remaining pure work is engineering, not a compiler blocker.
No Rust formatting/trait/pointer/flush-token recreation is required to duplicate existing numeric values.

offset-address.description: Checked numeric offset plus physical frame; adapter methods otherwise delegate to existing captured algorithms.

src/registers/debug.rs.review: Debug index/condition/size/DR6/DR7 pure algorithms implemented; zero-sized I/O proxies and trait boilerplate excluded.

src/registers/mod.rs.review: Module/reexport packaging only; implementations live in listed child modules.

src/registers/model_specific.rs.review: Identifiers, flags and STAR write plan implemented; read expansion/CET/APIC/reserved merges remain.

src/registers/mxcsr.rs.review: MXCSR flags/default implemented; live read/write tests excluded.

src/registers/rflags.rs.review: Flags implemented; reserved merge remains; raw IF/AC tests are ordinary bit expressions.

src/registers/segmentation.rs.review: Selectors and privilege implemented; FS/GS identifiers canonical; live segment operations excluded.

src/registers/xcontrol.rs.review: XCR0 facts implemented; ordered write-input checks and reserved merge remain.

src/structures/gdt.rs.review: Descriptor encodings, flags, metadata and append plan implemented; owned storage algorithms remain.

src/structures/idt.rs.review: Detached gate/options/frame/error/IDT arrays/codecs implemented; live handler/volatile/iretq interfaces excluded.

src/structures/mem_encrypt.rs.review: Address arithmetic already accepts a mask; explicit encryption config/state/polarity and dynamic PTE extraction remain.

src/structures/mod.rs.review: Descriptor-pointer representation/codecs implemented; measured layout limits recorded by descriptor slice.

src/structures/paging/frame.rs.review: Physical frame geometry/ranges implemented; value grants no backing; Kani remains finite evidence only.

src/structures/paging/frame_alloc.rs.review: Unsafe uniqueness/deallocation interfaces require real Extent ownership; no independent numeric algorithm missing.

src/structures/paging/mapper/mapped_page.review: Complete ordinary captured routes, size-discovering translation, branch and range cleanup have separate inventories; live mapping/allocator interfaces excluded.

src/structures/paging/mapper/mod.rs.review: Defaults/projections and numeric error/result branches covered; live traits and freely discardable flush tokens excluded.

src/structures/paging/mapper/offset_page.review: Trait methods delegate to mapped implementation; only explicit detached offset recipe/witness remains independent pure work.

src/structures/paging/mapper/recursive_p.review: Coordinates, observed constructor checks, distinct recursive routes/translate/cleanup remain; ordinary mapped behavior is only partial reuse.

src/structures/paging/mod.rs.review: Module/reexport packaging only; implementations live in listed child modules.

src/structures/paging/page.rs.review: Numeric geometry/Step/range queries implemented with documented checked-iterator deviations; no universal proof claim.

src/structures/paging/page_table.rs.review: Canonical PTE word/index/level and complete initialized table algorithms implemented; encryption profile remains separate.

src/structures/port.rs.review: PortRead/PortWrite are instruction/PortIo interfaces; no independent pure representation missing.

src/structures/tss.rs.review: TSS and I/O-map numeric validation/codecs implemented; backing/lifetime/loading excluded.
